# Vendored runtime libraries

- `exifr.js`: exifr 7.1.3, `dist/full.umd.js`, https://www.npmjs.com/package/exifr/v/7.1.3 (MIT).
- `fflate.js`: fflate 0.8.3, `umd/index.js`, https://www.npmjs.com/package/fflate/v/0.8.3 (MIT).

Unmodified distribution files. Licenses are retained alongside them. `build.cjs` embeds these files into the offline HTML and the worker's source. No CDN requests occur when the application runs.
